decisions.reason: Confirmed nonfatal source-attribution defect: Likharev chapter 4 pp. 8-11 (PDF pp. 62-65) discusses fixed-axis rotation, a pendulum, rolling, a ladder and the opening of free rotation; it contains no claimed warning about singular inertia. Reading pp. 12-14 also found no such warning in the symmetric-top discussion. Removed that reference. The local two-atom calculation gives total mass 2m0, zero first moment and I=diag(2m0 a^2,2m0 a^2,0); Rz(varpi t) fixes both atoms, so rotational energy and centre-of-mass angular momentum vanish. No logical claim requires the removed reference.
